title: Symbolic powers of a height-one prime in a complete local domain are eventually contained in the ordinary powers
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the eventual comparison between symbolic and ordinary powers of a height-one prime in a complete Noetherian local domain (author lemma at source lines 3693-3699, label lemma-inverse-system-symbolic-powers). The proof (source lines 3701-3719) runs through an inverse system: exactness of localization produces short exact sequences whose kernels are supported at the maximal ideal and hence Artinian, so the system is Mittag-Leffler (proof lines 3702-3710), and an element lying in every symbolic power is then shown to vanish by completing the localization and using faithful flatness (proof lines 3712-3718). The Mittag-Leffler step and the faithful-flatness conclusion are the two substantive moves. H2.
